newsitem.title: USA: Stant names CEO, sees record 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Stant names CEO, sees record 1996 results.

text.p: Stant Corp said Friday it has appointed John Reilly as president and chief executive officer, succeeding David Paridy, who retires after serving as president and chief executive officer since 1987.
Stant also said its 1996 results will reflect record operating results and record earnings per share.

Reilly, 53, served since 1995 as chairman of the board, president and chief executive officer of Figgie International Inc where he led a major restructuring of the company and its business units. From 1993 to 1994, he was president and chief operating officer of Brunswick Corp.
